response.answer: In vitro assays using conditional knockdown and in vivo models with microglial-specific manipulations best test indirect rtPA-mediated neuroprotection and inflammatory mediator dynamics. Co-culture systems and conditioned media transfer are effective in vitro methods. In vivo, conditional knockout models are used.

results.content: To test this, we performed scRNA-seq14.") on endothelial cells (CD31+/CD45−) isolated via fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) from brains of C57BL/6J mice subjected to middle cerebral artery occlusion (MCAO) and treated with PF-429242 or vehicle (Fig. 1a and Extended Data Fig. 1a–d). Seven days after MCAO, infarct volume was reduced by 75.6 ± 5.3% (*P* = 0.0002) in RGMaF155A/+ mice compared to WT control animals: infarct volume in control and RGMaF155A/+ groups was 27.0 ± 3.7% and 6.6 ± 1.1% of total brain volume, respectively (Extended Data Fig. 3g,h). Seven days after MCAO, brain infarct volume was reduced by 65.1 ± 6.7% (*P* = 0.0007) in TAM-induced *Neo*ΔTie2-creERT2 mice compared to vehicle-injected control animals: brain infarct volume in control and *Neo*ΔTie2-creERT2 groups was 25.8 ± 3.5% and 9.0 ± 1.2% of total brain volume, respectively (Extended Data Fig. 3g,h). ### Extended Data Fig. 3 Reduced ischemic brain injury after stroke in PF-429242 treated, RGMa-F155A/+ and *Neo*ΔTie2-creERT2 mice.
